champion.tips: EKKO TIPS AND TRICKS Use your Q to push the minion wave when the enemy is inside the wave. This allows you to push and poke them at the same time. Split push during the mid and late game if no team fights are occurring. Use your strong duelling potential to fight anyone who tries to stop you. In team fights, look to flank the enemy with your W . Use your W from fog of war and then engage once it's about to activate. If your team is not in a position to follow up- don’t go in!
champion.builds: THE BEST EKKO BUILDS, RUNES AND ITEMS FOR TOP IN EMERALD + Most Popular If you want to use the most popular Ekko Top build, you should take Flash and Teleport as your Summoner Spells. For runes, you should pick Hail of Blades as your keystone, followed by Sudden Impact, Grisly Mementos and Relentless Hunter in the primary tree, as well as Absolute Focus and Scorch in the secondary tree. For rune shards, you want Adaptive Force in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health Scaling in defense, though it depends on the matchup. Finally, for your items, you should build Hextech Rocketbelt as your first item, followed by Sorcerer's Shoes and Lich Bane. For your last 3 items, you should build Rabadon's Deathcap, Shadowflame and finish with Zhonya's Hourglass. For the skill order, you want to stick with Q - E - W. Right now, this build has 44.4% winrate over 160 matches played. Optional Your second option for Ekko Top build would be to take Flash and Teleport as your Summoner Spells. The runes that this build takes advantage of are Hail of Blades as your keystone, Sudden Impact, Grisly Mementos and Relentless Hunter in the primary tree, and Absolute Focus with Scorch in the secondary tree. The shards used in this build are Adaptive Force in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health Scaling in defense. The items for the build are Lich Bane, which you should build first, followed by Sorcerer's Shoes as your second item and Nashor's Tooth as your third item. The rest of the items in order are Rabadon's Deathcap, Zhonya's Hourglass and Shadowflame. The skill order for this build is Q - E - W. In the current patch, this build has a 51.9% win rate over 133 matches. Alternative If you're looking for alternatives, you can use Flash and Teleport as your Summoner Spells, with runes being Electrocute as your keystone, Sudden Impact, Grisly Mementos and Treasure Hunter in the primary tree, and Absolute Focus with Gathering Storm in the secondary tree, as well as Adaptive Force, Adaptive Force, and Health Scaling as your rune shards. The items that this build incorporates are Hextech Rocketbelt as your first item, then Sorcerer's Shoes as a second item and Lich Bane as a third item. You want to finish the build with Rabadon's Deathcap, Zhonya's Hourglass and Shadowflame. As far as ability max order goes, you want to keep it Q - E - W. This build is currently sitting at a 52.9% win rate across 70 matches played. Situational Ekko Runes and Items Depending on the context of your game, your matchup, and enemy champions, you might want to consider building some situational items or take specific runes. Carefully examine your team, enemy team, game state , and your matchup to plan your Ekko build accordingly! For example, when it comes to rune shards, you might want to take either Armor or Magic Resist, depending on which champion you are about to lane against. Furthermore, if you want a more detailed breakdown, you should also check out Ekko runes page.
